content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-poaching restriction exists anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: 14.5 Independent Contractors. The parties are independent contractors with respect to each other. Each party is not and shall not be deemed to be an employee, agent, partner or legal representative of the other for any purpose and shall not have any right, power or authority to create any obligation or responsibility on behalf of the other.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ" and "induce" return no restrictive covenant on personnel anywhere in the Agreement. The only personnel-related provisions are Section 13 (Shared Resources), which addresses access to Commerce One operations/consulting/engineering personnel, Employee NDA/Invention Agreements and ownership of Developments (p0116), Section 14.5 (independent contractors, p0126) and Exhibit D Section 5 (each party assigns a sales/marketing employee, p0203) — none of which restricts Corio from soliciting, hiring or engaging Commerce One personnel. This matches the preferred position of no non-solicit binding the Customer, so no redline is warranted.
